name: Lightning Mount
body:
You are able to leap into the saddle of your horse without thought, landing in the saddle by instinct.

Prerequisite(s): Mounted Combat

Benefit: Mounting or dismounting a mount is a free action for you, provided you start adjacent to your mount.

Normal: It normally requires a move equivalent action to mount or dismount a horse.
